data.title: Ellington House
data.about:
Welcome to Ellington House in Dubai Hills Estate. 

Offering you a choice of 1 – 3 bedroom apartments with fantastic golf course views, these homes are the perfect boutique apartments in Dubai. With ample space, and natural lighting inside the homes, this is the perfect place to call your home. With access ti the best of amenities, when you live at Ellington House, you will live an unparalleled lifestyle.

location_tile.title: Ellington House is located within Dubai Hills Estate, close to King’s College Hospital and Gems School.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Ellington House is located within Dubai Hills Estate, close to King’s College Hospital and Gems School. Dubai Hills Estate is a fantastic green community for families and individuals alike. With the highest levels of luxury golf course community lifestyle, this is ideal for golf lovers. Located just minutes from major landmarks of the city, this community is a sought after place to live in.

  • 10 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 10 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 12 mins – Jumeirah Beach
  • 20 mins – Dubai International Airport
